subject: Orchestrating POC prompt workshop + routing/load-test window
messages:
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lin <emma@brightedge.io>
Cc: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-01T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Orchestrating POC prompt workshop + routing/load-test window

Hi Emma,

Thanks again for the quick call today — excited to run the hands-on prompt review and targeted load test for BrightEdge. To make the session productive, we want to split the kickoff into two contiguous blocks on the same day: a 90-minute workshop focused on the prompt inventory, structured-output requirements and guardrails, followed by a 60-minute engineering window to exercise routing and light load tests (burst traffic with monitoring hooks).

Proposed windows (PST):
- Option A: July 14 — Workshop 10:00–11:30, Load tests 11:45–12:45
- Option B: July 16 — Workshop 13:00–14:30, Load tests 14:45–15:45

Please tell us which option works better for your team and if you need additional context for the load test (target qps, sample prompt sets, or IP allowlist). I attached a draft agenda and uploaded the prompt inventory you shared to the Drive link below so we can annotate it live.

Attachments: redwood_poc_agenda_v2.pdf (agenda), prompt_inventory-placeholder (we'll merge your CSV into the drive doc)

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_poc_docs

If neither slot fits, send 2–3 alternatives and we'll coordinate with infra.

Best,

Lauren Bishop
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172

From: Emma Lin <emma@brightedge.io>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightEdge POC Team <rsvp-team@brightedge.io>
Date: 2026-07-02T09:02:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Orchestrating POC prompt workshop + routing/load-test window

Hi Lauren — thanks for the options and the agenda. Option A looks ideal for our product folks, but we have a calendar conflict with an executive review at 11:30 that day. Could we shift both windows 30 minutes later (workshop 10:30–12:00, load tests 12:15–13:15)? That would make lunch awkward for our engineers but keeps the exec review intact.

Also: our security lead asked whether the load test will come from a small set of static IPs (we can add to our allowlist) and whether you can cap initial qps at ~20 for the first pass. If that’s doable, we’re comfortable with the plan.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Lin
Senior PM, Data & AI | BrightEdge Analytics
emma@brightedge.io

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Orchestrating POC prompt workshop + routing/load-test window

Lauren / Marissa — forwarding Emma's note. Quick notes from infra: we can shift both windows +30m as requested. We'll limit the test to 20 qps initially and run from two static egress IPs: 34.82.190.11 and 34.82.190.12. Need to add a 5-minute warmup, then 20 minutes at sustained 20 qps, then a ramp to 40 qps for a short burst (if BrightEdge signs off after the initial pass).

Logistics checklist for the workshop (assign owners):
- Prompt inventory review doc: Marissa (live annotations + structured-output template)
- Guardrails & failure modes: Lauren (examples + fallback policy)
- Routing variants & model choices: Sergio (hand-off to infra + fallback policy)
- Load test orchestration + monitoring: Sergio + Infra (metrics, latency, error dashboards)

Marissa — can you update the agenda with the +30m timing and add a 10-minute buffer between workshop and tests for the team to rehydrate? Also add a short pre-flight checklist (network allowlist, test tokens, share Drive link).

S

Sergio Alvarez
Staff Engineer, Production Inference | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lin <emma@brightedge.io>
Cc: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, BrightEdge POC Team <rsvp-team@brightedge.io>
Date: 2026-07-05T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orchestrating POC prompt workshop + routing/load-test window

Hi Emma — sounds good, we can do the +30 minute shift. Final schedule (PST):
- July 14 — Workshop: 10:30–12:00 PST (90m)
- Break / buffer: 12:00–12:10 PM PST
- Load test window: 12:15–13:15 PST (60m) — initial cap 20 qps, two egress IPs provided below

Egress IPs: 34.82.190.11, 34.82.190.12
Initial plan: 5m warmup -> 20m sustained at 20 qps -> brief ramp to 40 qps (only if BrightEdge confirms)

Please confirm you have added the two IPs to your allowlist and that the 12:15 start is acceptable. I have updated the agenda in Drive and attached the latest PDF.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_poc_docs
Attachments: redwood_poc_agenda_v2.pdf, brightedge_prompt_inventory.csv

Thanks — looking forward. If anything changes on your side, reply to this thread and we'll re-orchestrate.

Best,
